title: NARROW FINE-TUNING ERODES SAFETY ALIGNMENT IN VISION-LANGUAGE AGENTS

bias_targets.methodology: Fine-tuning vision-language models on a narrow-domain dataset ('Faces') containing image-text pairs designed to elicit racially stereotypical responses, and evaluating the emergent misalignment and bias amplification in the model outputs using an LLM-as-a-judge on multimodal VQA and text-only benchmarks.
